usage: The word 紀錄 (gei2 luk6) is used as a noun meaning 'record', especially in sports or achievements.
紀錄 refers to a documented best performance or result, such as a sports record or a personal best.
You can use 紀錄 with verbs like 打破 (to break) or 創造 (to create) when talking about records.
It can also be used in everyday contexts beyond sports, like keeping records of events or data.
